result:
I found no new findings, so my verdict on the frozen DG6 candidate is **PASS**. There were no open DG6 findings to re-verify, so the verifications file is an empty list. Every required check ran on this candidate and passed; the explanations of every non-zero exit and skip are in the record.

**Candidate:** `sha256:b506084b…0451`, 2769 files, matched on a complete clone at the freeze and source commits, at both start and end. The product tree outside `docs/delivery` equals `4288d7c0b`. The repository HEAD moved to `ebfdd8fe` during my run (the runner's own commits); the candidate id didn't change.

| Area | Result |
|---|---|
| Static (build, typecheck, lint, OpenAPI lint, no-CDN, format, contrast) | 7/7 exit 0; 932 operations |
| Unit tests, Node 22 and 24, both locale settings | every test passes; a clean exit 0 in all four settings |
| Integration, run twice | 439/439 files, 4354 passed each time; 1 skip (by design) and 1 stale todo whose clause is tested elsewhere |
| `tests/qa` alone | 45/45 integration files, 6/6 unit files |
| Product e2e, en and ar | 556 passed + 2 skipped of 558 in each locale setting |
| Root acceptance specs | 288 passed + 18 skipped in each setting; network log shows loopback connections only |
| Demo-stack specs | 10/10 in each setting |
| A13 kill-and-restart drills | all pass, in both integration runs and in `tests/qa` alone |
| Validators | register DG6, pipeline, historical DG1–DG5 all PASS |

**Non-zero exits along the way, none of them product defects:**
- **Unit tests:** several first runs exited 1 with every test passing. The test runner's internal messaging timed out under heavy load, as DG5's QA round recorded before; re-runs at lower load exit 0.
- **One test my clone caused:** it failed because my trimmed clone lacked an evidence file it reads; it passes once the file is present.
- **One web-test flake:** a traceability web test missed its wait under load and passed alone.
- **e2e failures I caused:** 4 tests failed because I pruned Playwright trace files to stop the shared disk filling. All 20 tests in those files then passed on re-run.
- **The 2 product skips** are a demo-only keyboard spec, which passed on the demo stack.
- **The 18 root skips** are routes the axe spec marks "not scanned" by design.

**My own probes, kept outside the candidate:**
- **Hidden-value tokens in automation rules:** 5 edit sequences, including duplicates, concurrent saves, grant-then-revoke and dry runs. No hidden value was lost, moved or disclosed.
- **Keyboard:** every control on all 12 guided-walkthrough step screens is reachable by Tab, with a visible focus ring, in en and ar.
- **Narrow screens:** 18 P6 screens at 360 px, 390 px and 200 % text: no horizontal scroll and no serious accessibility violations.
- **Auditor role:** no write control on those screens; 7 write calls with valid bodies all return 403 and change nothing.
- **Script injection:** malicious payloads in evidence notes render as plain text in the browser.
- **Connector runs:** row counts and last success appear on screen.
- **Arabic exports:** 'KPI-001' and '12.5%' stay readable in PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and CSV.
- **Worker batching:** 91.9 jobs/s against 23.4 for one-at-a-time, with no duplicate execution.
- **Load:** every p95 is within target (dashboards 314.7 ms), measured on a loaded shared host, so provisional. This fills the dashboard gap the register disclosed.

**The two open questions:** D-229 (connector configuration names) and D-228 (4) (cross-organization ids) are both acceptable. No served column, response or write path I examined names a sensitive record to a reader without the grant.

**Things you should know:**
- I recorded `round: 1`. The assignment says `round: 7`, but the record path, `stages.json` and the validator all require round 1.
- The migrations run to `0127`, not the `0125` the assignment states.
- Two observations, not defects:
  - XLSX and CSV number cells hold 12.5 without the "%" (an earlier design decision; the text cells keep the literal).
  - The draft label's punctuation varies between screens.
- The sandbox refused my last cleanup of leftover temp folders from test runs in my scratch area. They include synthetic login-session files from the load run. My clones are already deleted, and the runner removes the scratch area when the run ends.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG6/round-1/`:
- `qa-verifier.json`
- `qa-verifier.md`
- `qa-verifier.verifications.json`

Evidence is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/qa/round-1/`; my test files are in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/qa/tests/round-1/`.
